description: Label points for named parks: one on the largest part, from the park's min_label, plus one on each other part big enough to label, from the zoom at which it is 350 px from every larger part's point. Same-name parks that touch or nearly touch are one park.

attributes.name: min_label
attributes.description: Lowest zoom at which to show this point: for the main point, where the park's area is 32 px across; for another part's point, the latest of that, where the part itself is 32 px across, and where it is 350 px from every larger part's point.

attributes.name: area
attributes.description: Web Mercator area in m² of the park, or of the same-name group it belongs to.
